question: robot mascots vs site icons
vote: R2 WITH CHANGE: robots in big friendly places (hero, podium, AI pages, social pictures); line icons kept in small dense places; each robot gets a shape cue besides colour (Claude diamond antenna tip, Gemini two antenna balls, ChatGPT speech-bubble mouth)
why: The robots are far more memorable and match the trailer and Instagram, but at 18-20 px in tables a face with eyes and antenna turns to mush, and the line icons also differ by shape for colour-blind visitors. Using robots where there is room gives the brand without hurting readability or making the audits look like a cartoon.
